es: Distinguir en una negociación lo que alguien pide (postura) de lo que necesita (interés) y localizar el punto en común.

vocabulary.es: dispuesto a ceder, flexible en algo

teaching.en: In a negotiation, a position is what you ask for, and an interest is why you ask.
teaching.es: En una negociación, la postura es lo que pides y el interés es por qué lo pides.
teaching.explanationEs: Position = la petición; interest = la razón. Preguntar why distingue ambas.
segments: In a negotiation, a position is what you ask
for, and an interest is why you ask.
teaching.audioText: In a negotiation, a position is what you ask for, and an interest is why you ask.

teaching.en: The tenant's position is «lower the rent», but her underlying interest is to save money for her course.
teaching.es: La postura de la inquilina es «bajar el alquiler», pero su interés de fondo es ahorrar para su curso.
teaching.explanationEs: Underlying interest: la necesidad real que hay debajo de la petición.
segments: The tenant's position is «lower the rent», but her

teaching.en: The seller's priority is a quick sale, so he is flexible about the price.

teaching.explanationEs: Priority = lo que más importa; flexible about = se puede ceder en eso.

teaching.en: We both want a quiet flat, so we have common ground and can negotiate from there.

es: Formular concesiones condicionadas y contraofertas con provided that, as long as, unless y otherwise en una negociación de ocho turnos.

prompt.es: Escribe un diálogo de ocho turnos con dos concesiones condicionadas y una contraoferta.

answer.text: Ana: Hello, Leo. I would like to rent your hall on Saturdays for a small market. I can offer 300 dollars a month. Leo: That is too low. I need 400, because I pay for heating and cleaning. Ana: I understand. Here is my counteroffer: 350 dollars, and we clean the hall after every market. Leo: I can accept 350 as long as you clean it before six in the evening. Ana: Agreed, provided that you give us the keys on Friday night. Leo: I will give you the keys unless there is a private party on Saturday morning. Ana: That is fair, but please tell me by Thursday; otherwise, we will plan the first market for next month. Leo: Deal. I will send you a written agreement tomorrow, and you can sign it on Saturday.

Ana: Let me make a counteroffer: 340 dollars, provided that we may use the kitchen. Leo: You can use the kitchen as long as everything is clean when you leave. Ana: Of course.
